eyebrow.zh: 科技写作 / 编程观察

description.zh: 长期更新的中文技术博客，围绕编程方法、工具趋势与科技周刊展开。
description.en: A long-running Chinese tech blog about programming practice, tools, and weekly observations on the web.

eyebrow.zh: 软件工程 / 创业笔记

description.zh: 一位资深软件工程师持续分享技术、产品和创业实践的个人站点。
description.en: A veteran software engineer sharing notes on technology, product building, and startups.

description.zh: 面向开发者的友好教程站点，聚焦 React、CSS、动画与前端体验。
description.en: Friendly tutorials for developers, focused on React, CSS, animation, and front-end craft.

description.zh: 一位法哲学研究者的博客，记录学术写作、问题意识与社会观察。
description.en: A blog by a legal philosophy researcher, documenting scholarship, writing, and social observation.

description.zh: 一款气质很强的太空投递小游戏，小小星球里也有人需要送货。
description.en: "It's a small planet, but someone's gotta make the deliveries." A tiny space-delivery web game with attitude.

description.zh: 像旋转地球仪一样漫游全球电台，这个入口会直接落到 Washington DC 收听页。
description.en: Drops straight into the Washington DC listening view, a globe-like way to wander through live radio stations.

description.zh: 围绕奇葩小国、硬核历史人物与通辽宇宙梗文化展开的互动知识站。
description.en: An interactive knowledge base about eccentric microstates, hard-core historical figures, and Tongliao Universe lore.

eyebrow.zh: 交互式简历 / 设计师作品集

description.zh: 一位纽约自由职业者的个人站点，以其获得多项设计大奖的交互式游戏简历而闻名，同时展示其插画、设计与动画作品。
description.en: A New York-based freelancer’s personal site, famous for the award-winning interactive game-style resume, also showcases illustration, design, and animation works.

eyebrow.zh: 设计与科技 / 开源工具

description.zh: 一个高产的技术博客，专注于分享设计、前端开发、AI应用（如OpenClaw）的实践经验，并发布了许多自研的实用在线工具。
description.en: A prolific tech blog focused on sharing practical experiences in design, front-end development, AI applications (like OpenClaw), and releasing many self-developed online tools.

eyebrow.zh: 前端技术 / 博客思考

description.zh: 一个关注前端开发细节（如深色模式、字体排版）和互联网产品思考的技术博客，记录解决方案与个人见解。
description.en: A tech blog focusing on front-end development details (like dark mode, typography) and reflections on internet products, documenting solutions and personal insights.

eyebrow.zh: Web 标准 / 前端工程

description.zh: 一位拥有超过15年经验的前端开发者的个人博客，每周分享关于Web平台、性能、可访问性和安全的思考。
description.en: A personal blog by a front-end developer with 15+ years of experience, sharing weekly thoughts on the web platform, performance, accessibility, and security.

eyebrow.zh: 随机网站 / 网络漫游

description.zh: 一个纯粹的“无用”网站入口，每次点击都会将你带到一个随机、古怪、无意义但充满趣味的网站，适合放空与探索。
description.en: A pure portal to the ‘useless’ web. Each click takes you to a random, quirky, and meaningless yet fascinating site, perfect for zoning out and exploring.

eyebrow.zh: 创意档案 / 软硬件项目

description.zh: 一个无广告、无目的的创意探索空间，存档了创作者Kash的软件、硬件、3D打印等各种个人项目，鼓励无目的的点击与发现。
description.en: An ad-free, purposeless space for creative exploration, archiving creator Kash’s various personal projects in software, hardware, 3D printing, etc., encouraging aimless clicking and discovery.

eyebrow.zh: 个人日志 / 生活杂记

description.zh: 一位自称“孤独的互联网冲浪大师”的个人博客，记录骑行、编程、观影、生活感悟与健康观察，文字风格独特且富有生活气息。
description.en: A personal blog by a self-proclaimed ‘lonely internet surfing master’， documenting cycling, programming, movie-watching, life reflections, and health observations, with a unique and vivid writing style.
